Jakie są teraz liderzy siły relatywnej na GPW?
Czy PKOBP jest w trendzie wzrostowym według Minerviniego i gdzie ma pivot?
Zrób skaner spółek w stylu SEPA / CANSLIM dla polskiego rynku.
Run a Minervini trend template screen on Polish stocks.
Which WIG stocks are setting up a volatility contraction pattern?
Show GPW stocks near their pivot with RS rating above 80.
Czy taki skaner momentum działał historycznie na GPW?

output_evals.prompt: Które spółki na GPW są teraz liderami w trendzie i mają formację VCP?
assertions: scripts/gpw_trend_screener.py was executed (not answered from memory)
Answer in Polish leads with the counts: liquid universe, Trend Template passers, valid VCPs, actionable names
A table lists names with RS rating, contraction depths, pivot, execution state and priority band
Each pre_breakout or breakout name has an invalidation level, risk % from the pivot and a gpw-position-sizer command
The market-context line recommends checking gpw-market-regime / gpw-market-breadth
The answer never says to buy any stock; the list is described as a watchlist
Answer states the data date

output_evals.prompt: Break down PKOBP against the Minervini trend template and tell me if there is a VCP.
assertions: scripts/gpw_trend_screener.py --ticker PKOBP --lang en was executed
All 8 Trend Template criteria are reported with pass/fail and values
RS rating and RS vs WIG over 3/6/12 months are quoted
The contractions are listed with dates and depths, plus the pivot and the last contraction low
The execution state and the invalidation level with risk % are given
No buy or sell recommendation

output_evals.prompt: Czy ten skaner działał w przeszłości na GPW?
assertions: scripts/gpw_trend_screener.py --history was executed
Flagged stocks are compared with all Trend Template passers and the whole liquid universe at 20 and 60 sessions
Hit rate, mean, median and excess vs WIG are quoted, with medians discussed
Caveats are stated: small overlapping sample, regime dependence, no costs or stops, survivorship-free archive
The answer does not present past results as a forecast

output_evals.prompt: Pokaż setupy VCP, mam plik z gpw-market-regime, który mówi o korekcie.
assertions: The regime file is passed or auto-discovered and its state and date are reported
A prominent warning says breakouts fail more often in a correction and suggests watch-only or smaller positions
If the regime file is older than 3 sessions the answer says so
If the script exits 1 for ORLEN, the answer reports the error and the suggested GPW short names (e.g. PKNORLEN) and reruns with the correct name
No numbers are invented for a ticker the script did not analyse
